name: guiderail
description: Save, revisit and export ChatGPT replies as local Markdown notes.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/build-content.mjs && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs && node scripts/check-build.mjs
scripts.package:cws: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/package-cws.mjs
scripts.release:cws: npm run check:privacy && npm test && npm run build:release && node scripts/package-cws.mjs
scripts.release:local: npm run check:privacy && npm test && npm run build:release && npm run build:companion && node scripts/package-release.mjs
